compiled_state.description:
Write the grep-verification fitness function test that enforces zero legacy config key references outside the allowlist.

## Testing Mode: RED

## File to Create
tests/scripts/test-legacy-cleanup-grep.sh

## Fitness Function Pattern (AP-5 style)
Baseline capture: Run the grep FIRST against current state to enumerate all current violations (should be ~31 files). Document these as BASELINE_VIOLATIONS. The test asserts that the grep count is ZERO outside the allowlist — this fails (RED) until all cleanup tasks complete.

## Test Functions
1. test_no_legacy_key_refs_in_scope_files
   - Given: The repo tree under plugins/dso/skills, plugins/dso/scripts, plugins/dso/hooks, .github/workflows
   - When: grep -rln 'merge\.strategy\|enforcement\.strategy\|worktree\.isolation_enabled\|attribution\.enabled\|DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' <scope> is run with ALLOWLIST applied
   - Then: Output is empty (exit code 1 from grep, which is "no matches") — all files have been cleaned
   - FAILS now because ~31 files currently have refs

## Allowlist (files exempt from the grep check)
The following files are always permitted to reference legacy keys:
- plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh (the migrator itself)
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh (the compat shim)
- CLAUDE.md, docs/adr/, plugins/dso/docs/ (reference/historical docs)
- tests/ tree (separate scope check if added)

## Implementation Notes
- Use grep -rl + filter to exclude allowlisted files before asserting empty output
- The test passes when grep finds ZERO non-allowlisted files
- Set executable bit: chmod +x tests/scripts/test-legacy-cleanup-grep.sh
- .test-index: add RED marker for this test since basename doesn't match any source file; use a descriptive entry

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
